annotations.title: Add an email address to a domain

description: Give a domain an email address whose mail lands in the Hermoso inbox (list_inbox, list_domain_mail), replies sent from it: address is ANY name (sales, jane) or * for all. A bought domain has it at once. A CONNECTED domain with no email moves its DNS to Hermoso: a dry run first (email already at Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or elsewhere stays, and nothing changes), then confirm:true copies its DNS records and answers two nameservers to set; the address is made once they switch (list_domain_mail shows progress and live MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC). replaceExistingEmail:true only when the user explicitly moves existing email; cancel:true undoes a setup; forwardTo also forwards a copy; remove:true with confirm:true removes an address. Free.

address.description: the part before the @ (any name), or * for every address

confirm.description: true only after the user approved it

forwardTo.description: also forward a copy to this inbox
